crossRefs.note: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know…
and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and…
He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

translations.web: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
translations.bsb: When the layer of dew had evaporated, there were thin flakes on the desert floor, as fine as frost on the ground.
translations.kjv: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
translations.asv: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness a small round thing, small as the hoar-frost on the ground.
